newsitem.title: USA: US real wage growth may be understated-Chicago Fed.
newsitem.headline: US real wage growth may be understated-Chicago Fed.

text.p: - U.S. real, inflation-adjusted wage growth may be significantly higher than indicated by standard measurements and probably tracks productivity gains closely, a senior economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago said on Wednesday.

"Americans are richer than they think, it's one way to put it," Chicago Fed Asssistant Vice President Daniel Sullivan told Reuters at the Chicago Fed conference where the bank released its year-long study on "The Midwest Economy: Looking back for the Future."
